edition: Archived final 2024 manual through Team Update 21

kickoffComparison.scope: STAGE point values, ordinary ENSEMBLE thresholds, assessment time and nominal field dimensions agree. Retain the final wording of contact and interference rules for this study.

clock.assessment: Earliest of all robots at rest after TELEOP or 5 s after time expires. Actuator commands stop at the buzzer.

eligibility.park: Bumpers intersect the alliance Stage Zone at assessment and robot does not qualify as ONSTAGE.
eligibility.onstage: Use section 6.5.2's allowed-contact list at assessment. Ground contact disqualifies the hang. A reached chain alone is insufficient.
eligibility.spotlit: A HIGH NOTE surrounds the microphone corresponding to the chain supporting the ONSTAGE robot.
eligibility.harmony: Qualifying robots share one chain through direct or transitive support. Apply once per additional robot.
eligibility.clock: The last 20 seconds affect protection and human HIGH NOTE timing. Earlier lawful approaches are possible.

qualificationRanking.officialAwardOverride: G424 can award an ENSEMBLE RP in qualifications. Track any referee award separately from modeled robot and alliance match points.

geometry.scope: Nominal geometry, see installed field survey and loaded-chain estimates in the climber study.
